description: Check out the Launch Trailer for Thomas & Friends: Wonders of Sodor, an adventure game based on the hit Thomas & Friends IP developed by Dovetail Games. author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at Cursed Words in this new trailer for the upcoming roguelike game. It all starts quite simple: use tiles on the board to make words, aiming to score enough points each round to earn some money and keep your progress going. But as the score targets get higher and bosses with more punishing abilities begin to appear, winning will definitely require a rather creative definition of what qualifies as a “word”. Cursed Words will be available on PC via Steam on April 2, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Cursed Words - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Spook-A-Boo announcement trailer for the upcoming ghost-hunting co-op adventure game to meet the characters and see gameplay. Spook-A-Boo will be available on PC (Steam), Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S. A demo is out now on Steam.

Spook-A-Boo welcomes you and up to three friends to join D.E.D (Dimensional Entity Department) and hunt down and capture troublemaking ghosts across time and space. Armed with an assortment of gadgets to locate, lure, and trap ghosts hidden in plain sight coordination is key.
title: Spook-A-Boo - Official Console Announcement Trailer

description:
Get your first look at Escape By Spoon, a new 1930s-animation-style first-person escape game where you must dig your way out of a prison with only a spoon, but watch out for what horrors lurk in the tunnels of the underground. You'll make progress, discover loot, upgrade your gear, and try to get even farther on your next run. 
Wishlist Escape By Spoon on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4298700/Escape_By_Spoon/?curator_clanid=45995546

#EscapeBySpoon #Gaming #IGN

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Marathon is waking. Prepare. Watch the Marathon Cryo Archive launch trailer for the sci-fi extraction shooter game. The final ARG puzzle has been resolved by the community, and Marathon's first end-game zone, Cryo Archive, is unlocked. The Cryo Archive zone is aboard the abandoned UESC Marathon and focuses on high‑intensity PvPvE combat, Vault chases, and risky extractions. It features six wings full of cryopods, medical bays, and storage areas, plus seven high‑security Vaults that offer top‑tier loot and unique weapons. Players must be Level 25, have all factions unlocked, and equip at least a 5,000 credit loadout.

Marathon's Cryo Archive opens on March 20, 2026.
title: Marathon - Official Cryo Archive Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Demo Launch Trailer for Xanniban, a point-and-click survival action horror game developed by NeeTroo Games. Players will explore a sprawling facility in the Trespasser's Vessel to dispatch machines gone rogue. Engage in the high-octane action, make use of advanced movement techniques, and shoot through enemies to contain them. Xanniban is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Xanniban - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest trailer for The Precinct to see what to expect with the latest update for the neon-noir action sandbox game. The Ambulance update allows you to take on more responsibilities with the addition of ambulance and coroner roles. Other additions include a new coroner vehicle, a hospital and morgue on West Island, and the ability to switch into paramedic or coroner outfits directly from vehicles. Gameplay updates include new collectible stashes unlocked at Police Officer Rank 7 and improved police AI that can pull suspects out of hiding. New ambulance-themed music tracks have been added to both the base game and downloadable content. The Ambulance update for The Precinct is available now for free on PC (via Steam and the Epic Games Store), and the update will launch on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X/S on March 24, 2026.
title: The Precinct - Official Ambulance Update Trailer

Jesus Simulator is launching on March 23 for PC (Steam).

description: Take a look at the Stellar Freight: Endless Horizon announcement trailer for the upcoming 2D sci-fi roguelike game about a space trucker who faces new events every single turn. Cargo transportation, combat, trading, ship upgrades, crew management, and more are core parts of the experience. The goal is to survive as long as possible - the player has only one life. Stellar Freight: Endless Horizon will be available on Steam in Q3 2026.

description:

description:
Check out the announcement trailer for The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon, an upcoming point-and-click adventure game that brings six new cases where Detective McQueen and Officer Dooley might have to get a bit serious. Like 1% serious. .1% serious? .01% serious? Misdemeanours nap and corruption rarely gets out of bed but crime? Crime never sleeps...

The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam. In the 'Honey, I Shrunk the Detectives' case demo, McQueen and Dooley find themselves on their biggest case yet-- shrunk to the size of mice in the Darkside Division office, surrounded by magical artifacts, talking rats, and a particularly poor plumbing system.
title: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon - Official Announcement Trailer
